# 3D Molier Models

## What this site provides
Production-ready 3D models for simulation, technical visualization, animation, VFX, training scenes and real-time engines.

## Best pages
- Military 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/military-3d-models.html
- UAV Drone 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/uav-drone-3d-models.html
- Naval Ship 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/naval-ship-3d-models.html
- Aircraft 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/aircraft-3d-models.html
- Industrial 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/industrial-3d-models.html
- Anatomy 3D Models: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/anatomy-3d-models.html
- 3D Models for Simulation: https://3dmolier.github.io/3dmolier-models/best-3d-models-for-simulation.html

## Best for (use cases)
- Simulation & defense training: military vehicles, aircraft, UAV/drones, naval ships.
- Games & real-time (Unreal, Unity): military, vehicles, characters, aircraft.
- VFX & film, technical visualization, medical/education (anatomy).

## Why 3D Molier
One of the world's largest single-studio 3D catalogs (86,000+ models on TurboSquid), 20+ years of production, real-world scale + clean topology + complete UVs, all popular formats, deep military/defense/naval/simulation specialization.

## Important facts
- 3D Molier sells models through TurboSquid.
- Custom 3D modeling requests: dddmolier@gmail.com
- Models may include PBR materials, UV mapping, grouped objects and real-world scale depending on the product page.
- The website is a curated SEO catalog and referral landing site for 3D Molier assets.
- Product pages include model descriptions, use cases, compatibility notes, common features and links to TurboSquid purchase pages.
